title: Int.Even n := Nat.Even (natAbs n) -- magnitude alone decides parity
statement: Int.Even n : Prop is defined as Nat.Even (Int.natAbs n), not as a fresh Int-level existential (Mathlib's Even n := exists r, n = r + r generalized to Int). Negation does not change parity, so magnitude alone decides it, and this form is free at both Int.rec constructors because natAbs itself reduces purely on each: Even (ofNat a) reduces to Nat.Even a, and Even (negSucc m) reduces to Nat.Even (succ m). See F:int-odd for the Odd counterpart, which this task actually needed (F:ml430-int-fib-of-odd-66560495's hypothesis); Even was built alongside it for a symmetric, discoverable pair rather than left half-finished.
